title: feat(types)!: a static chart node's series refuses the renderer-internal measureFormat carrier by name
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoXTQqmXNfk1Sih3H15nJjBz)_

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the key is renderer-internal and taught nowhere (`git grep measureFormat -- skills content` finds 0)

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者或 AI 在页面里手写静态图表时，如果给数据系列写了只该由报表和仪表盘自动填的「数值格式」，保存时会被拒绝并说明原因；报表和仪表盘图表的坐标轴显示不变。
- 属于「作者界面只接受渲染器会正确使用的东西」这条线，替用 AI 写页面元数据的搭建者堵住一个会和数据本身矛盾的手写格式。
- 只影响手写了这个内部键的静态图表，它们需要删掉这个键（要改坐标轴格式就写坐标轴自己的格式）；这是收窄，可以直接撤回这个 PR。
- 无

## What changes
- `@object-ui/types` `ChartDataSeriesSchema` (`zod/data-display.zod.ts`) declares `measureFormat` as a `retirementTombstone`, beside the `aggregate` refusal it mirrors. The series object is non-strict, so until now an authored `measureFormat` was kept in the parse output and honoured by the renderer. It is now refused with one `invalid_type` issue at `series.N.measureFormat`; the guidance names the key, says the report and dashboard producers fill it, and points at the authored channel, the axis `format` (`yAxis: [{ field, format }]`), which already takes precedence over the carrier.
- The TS twin `ChartDataSeries` (`data-display.ts`) types it `measureFormat?: never`, so a typed literal fails `tsc`.
- The producers are untouched: `DatasetReportRenderer` and `DatasetWidget` build their series past this schema and keep filling the carrier.
- ADR-0087 D3 entry `chart-series-measure-format-carrier-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.chart-series-measure-format-carrier-refused.ts`); no D2 conversion, because the carrier has no authored equivalent to rewrite into.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/types` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor (the ledger entry ships in its migration registry), with the FROM → TO row and the `adr-0087: registered` marker.

## Tests
- `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-series-aggregate-refusal-11681.test.ts` (the existing series-refusal harness), two new top-level `describe`s:
  - each of three carriers (`{ format: '0.0%', percentScale: 'whole' }`, `{ format: '0,0.00', currency: 'CNY' }`, `{}`) is refused by `ChartDataSeriesSchema` with exactly one `invalid_type` issue at `measureFormat` whose message names the key;
  - a static chart node carries the refusal to `series.0.measureFormat`, with the control node parsing;
  - a series that writes both `aggregate` and `measureFormat` is refused at both paths, so the `aggregate` refusal stays;
  - CONTROL: `yAxis: [{ field, format }]` on the same node parses;
  - the zod arm's input type is exactly `undefined` and the TS twin's member is `never` (type-level `Eq`), and a typed literal carrying it is a `@ts-expect-error`.

Seven exited non-zero on the first pass for local prerequisites, not this diff, and passed on a re-run: five needed a `pnpm install` after the worktree was fast-forwarded to a base whose lockfile adds a link, and the dogfood build closure (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, the cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` test); `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone; `ui` `vitest run scripts/` needed the built closure (`Test Files  172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests  5144 passed | 2 skipped (5146)`).

## Acceptance notes
- The refusal reaches what parses through `@object-ui/types` (the static SDUI chart node's zod face) and the TS authoring face. The spec's own `ChartSeriesSchema` already refuses the key as unknown, so no spec schema changes.
- The renderer still reads `measureFormat` off a raw node it is handed; this PR closes the authoring door, not the reader, which the producers need.
- The prepared patch held by zone a4-U was asked for on the card (comment 7232258512) and did not arrive by the claim's 03:30Z cut-off, so this was written from the card's "Shape of the fix".

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`: the `measureFormat` arm after `aggregate` and its guidance string.
2. `ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts`: `measureFormat?: never` at the end of `ChartDataSeries`.
3. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.chart-series-measure-format-carrier-refused.ts`.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm --filter @object-ui/types exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-series-aggregate-refusal-11681.test.ts` shows 15 passing; rename the zod arm's key and the same command shows 5 failing.
